request: 동동 2026-11-18: 지금까지 만들고 시험한 전략 중 승률이 높은 것들을 모아 특징을 찾고, 승률은 낮지만 손실이 작은 것들을 모아 특징을 찾고, 서로 합칠 수 있는지 연구
status: committed before any daily series of this study is computed; Part 1 reads only already-published result files
honesty: S1 and S2 of every family were already looked at (many times for the scale-in family). Everything here is post-hoc exploration on spent DEV data, not evidence. No prereg is activated, no window is opened.

part1_catalog.sources: every published DEV result file that records a per-trade / per-cycle hit rate (list fixed in run/winloss_catalog.py SOURCES); duplicate re-scorings of the same candidates under other cost rows are listed once (primary measured / public-estimate cost row)
part1_catalog.unit: one row per (family, config, segment S1/S2)
part1_catalog.missing_rule: a value not recorded in the source is reported as null ('기록 없음'), never estimated

groups_on_S1.B_low_win_small_loss: hit_rate <= 0.45 and n >= 30 and every recorded loss metric is small: worst single trade/cycle >= -1000 bp (if recorded) and S1 max drawdown <= 30% (if recorded) and payoff >= 1.5 (if recorded); if no loss metric is recorded the row is B_undetermined

part2_rerun_profile.why_not_counted: re-runs of configs already counted in ADR 0044/0088/0089 (R9 candidates on a 7-symbol subset are a restricted re-scoring used only to assign group membership)
part2_rerun_profile.A_members: ADR 0088 bases B1..B4 (N30 s.04 K4, N30 s.08 K2, N90 s.04 K4, N90 s.08 K2), 5x, no stop, market entry, 17-alt daily engine (dca_stop_dev.simulate_stop with stop none = ADR 0088 exactly), measured cost row

B_candidates.B_DS: ADR 0089 average-close stop configs of the same four bases, x in {0.06, 0.10} (8 configs, same signal as A)
B_candidates.B_R9: the 33 R9 entry-bar candidates (ADR 0044 engine path, candidate_regime_dev.score_candidate), symbols restricted to the 7 liquid ones present in the project archive (BNB XRP SOL ADA DOGE LTC LINK; BTC/ETH are not in the archive and the exchange is unreachable here), public-estimate cost estimate_v3_alts, trades booked on entry day

part2_rerun_profile.B_membership_rule: S1 trade/cycle hit_rate <= 0.45 and S1 payoff (mean win / |mean loss|) >= 1.5 and S1 n >= 30
part2_rerun_profile.A_membership_check: A members are reported with their S1 hit rate; the analysis keeps all four even if one falls below 0.60
part2_rerun_profile.bundles: equal-weight mean of member daily net series (A, B_DS, B_R9); a B bundle with fewer than 2 members is dropped
part2_rerun_profile.regime: market = equal-weight mean of next-open-to-open returns of the 17 alts; up day if trailing 90-day cumulative market return known at the day's start is > 0 (30-day variant also reported)
stats: Pearson and Spearman daily correlation A vs each B bundle in S1 and S2, all days and per regime
mean daily net sign of each bundle in each cell S1/S2 x up/down, and calendar 2022
per-trade avg win, avg loss, payoff, worst, liquidation share of every member

gate_for_part3: Part 3 runs for a B bundle only if its S1 daily Pearson correlation with A is <= 0.30; if no B bundle passes the gate, Part 3 is not run and no trials are spent

part3_combination_grid.counted_trials: 28 if both B bundles pass the gate (10 per B bundle + 8 exit-mix rows); rows of a B bundle that fails the gate are not run and not counted; the 8 exit-mix rows are counted if B_DS passes
part3_combination_grid.scaling: before combining, each bundle is scaled to have the same S1 daily standard deviation as A (scale factor computed on S1 only and applied unchanged to S2)
rows_per_B_bundle: regime switch 90d: up -> A, down -> B; and up -> B, down -> A (2)
regime tilt 90d: up -> 0.75A/0.25B, down -> 0.25A/0.75B; and the reverse (2)
part3_combination_grid.exit_mix_rows: same-signal exit mixing on the scale-in signal: for each base B1..B4, half capital follows the no-stop rule and half the avg-close stop x in {0.06, 0.10} (8) = 0.5*series(none) + 0.5*series(stop x), equivalent to two independent half-size books on the same signals
part3_combination_grid.selection: choose the single row with the highest S1 annualised SR (measured / public-estimate cost)
part3_combination_grid.pass_rule: combination counts as useful only if ALL: (a) S1 SR of the chosen row > expected max SR of N skill-less trials for N = grid size AND for N = cumulative DEV trials (dev_search_trials.jsonl sum + pending unmerged ADR 0091 32 if not yet in the file + this grid); (b) S2 SR > 0.5; (c) the row's SR is higher than the better of its two components in BOTH S1 and S2; (d) S1 and S2 envelope/close max drawdown not worse than the worse component. Otherwise NOT_USEFUL
also_reported: S1 SR, S2 SR, ann return, close max drawdown, worst 20-day sum, daily hit rate of every row
how many rows beat both components in S1 and in S2
